en.titre:
10/10 hobbies that feel like a
game if you have adhd

colonne: you see the pins fall in seconds, so your brain gets a reward ten times a game and _never drifts_
en.chute: most alleys have cheap games on weeknights

colonne: a plan turns running into a game with clear steps, and finishing a week feels like a _small win_
_pro tip_: i use atala, an ai running coach that plans my week around my goal
en.chute: pick a 5k three months from now

colonne: each hole has its own trick, so a brain that bores fast always has a _new problem_ to solve
en.chute: go on a quiet weekday evening

colonne: looking for the small symbol or strange detail turns a painting into a treasure hunt
_pro tip_: i use artura, one artwork a day with its story, zooming into the details you'd miss
en.chute: look for one hidden object per painting

colonne: each question is quick, your team counts on you, and the score keeps everyone _locked in_
en.chute: most pubs run a free quiz every week
